pretrained_candidates.name: SpiderBot v1 YOLOv8n
pretrained_candidates.fit: Lightweight general corrosion detector; no pump identification or separate pitting class. Original author reports only nine validation images. Current Android class mapping is incompatible.

pretrained_candidates.name: Decizez Lite YOLOv8 segmentation
pretrained_candidates.classes: Full checkpoint class order not inspected; card describes rust levels, cars, screws, pipes and metal plates
pretrained_candidates.fit: Published 6.79 MB checkpoint; segmentation output is incompatible with current detection-only Android decoder. Dataset rights and exact labels require verification.

pretrained_candidates.name: BuildingBlocks corrosion-9ge01
pretrained_candidates.fit: Relevant pitting labels, but no verified downloadable .pt checkpoint. Public metrics are poor; hosted API cannot replace an offline local model. Not a pump-specific dataset.

dataset_candidates.name: Roboflow 100 corrosion-bi3q3, public smoke subset
dataset_candidates.fit: General industrial corrosion smoke test only; not evidence of target-pump performance; excluded from training pending group/label review.

dataset_candidates.name: Images and pixel annotations for corrosion segmentation
dataset_candidates.annotation: 1024 field images; 35 selected images with sparse 5x5 pixel patches, not complete YOLO boxes
dataset_candidates.fit: Additional corrosion surfaces only; must filter pumps, review groups and create detection labels. Not downloaded automatically.

dataset_candidates.name: Corrosion in Industrial Complexes in Ostrava
dataset_candidates.annotation: 105 industrial images with corrosion segmentation masks
dataset_candidates.fit: Source record did not expose a clear license in checked content. Not downloaded or approved for training. Not pump-specific.

dataset_candidates.name: Local pump reference photographs
dataset_candidates.annotation: None; three images of split-case pumps from public refurbishment case studies
dataset_candidates.fit: Reference inspection only. Excluded from train/val/test.
